lines.zh: 叶子拖在花园的土上，走一步响一声。
lines.en: My leaves drag on the garden soil and rustle at every step.

lines.zh: 我踩着腐叶往前挪，秆子一节节响。
lines.en: I shift forward over rotten leaves, each stalk joint creaking.

lines.zh: 花园里没有风，动的是我自己。
lines.en: There is no wind in this garden; the movement is me.

lines.zh: 棒子太沉了，我只能歪着走。
lines.en: The cob is too heavy, so I walk tilted.

lines.zh: 茎秆折了半截，剩下半截还认得路。
lines.en: Half my stalk is broken; the rest still knows the way.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我一步一步压过来。
lines.en: I do not run; I press forward one step at a time.

lines.zh: 叶鞘蹭过石阶，留下绿色的汁。
lines.en: My leaf sheaths scrape the stone steps and leave green juice.

lines.zh: 我朝你的气味走，不快，但不停。
lines.en: I walk toward your smell, not fast, but never stopping.

lines.zh: 这具身体走起来像在拖一捆柴。
lines.en: This body walks like it is dragging a bundle of firewood.

lines.zh: 别回头，我已经在你身后了。
lines.en: Do not turn around; I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草籽粘在叶子上。
lines.en: Where I pass, grass seeds stick to my leaves.

lines.zh: 一步一晃，粒在里面挤得直响。
lines.en: Each swaying step makes the kernels click inside me.

lines.zh: 我站着晒太阳，粒在里面慢慢变硬。
lines.en: I stand in the sun while the kernels harden inside me.

lines.zh: 没有风的时候，我自己摇叶子。
lines.en: When there is no wind, I shake my own leaves.

lines.zh: 秆子里有汁往上爬，很慢。
lines.en: Sap climbs slowly up my stalk.

lines.zh: 我在数花园里还剩几朵花。
lines.en: I am counting how many flowers this garden has left.

lines.zh: 站久了，我的根就往土里钻一点。
lines.en: Standing long makes my roots sink deeper into the soil.

lines.zh: 棒子太沉，我把腰弯下去歇一会。
lines.en: The cob is too heavy, so I bend down and rest a while.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西嚼叶子，不是我。
lines.en: Something far off is chewing leaves, and it is not me.

lines.zh: 叶尖卷起来了，我该喝点水。
lines.en: My leaf tips have curled; I should drink something.

lines.zh: 我不睡，植物没有睡觉的地方。
lines.en: I do not sleep; plants have nowhere to sleep.

lines.zh: 这层绿皮裹得我喘不上气。
lines.en: This green husk wraps me so tight I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 安静得让我想弄出点声音来。
lines.en: It is so quiet that I want to make some noise.

lines.zh: 我在等一个自己走进来的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone who walks in on their own.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的须，像有人在挠。
lines.en: Wind runs through my silk as if someone were scratching me.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的粒埋回脚边的土里。
lines.en: I bury the fallen kernels back into the soil at my feet.

lines.zh: 我的须被风吹得发响，很吵。
lines.en: The wind rattles my silk. Loud.

lines.zh: 我在想那朵花开在哪一边。
lines.en: I wonder which side that flower opened on.

lines.zh: 土里有什么在动，压着根。
lines.en: Something stirs in the soil, pressing my roots.

lines.zh: 这身绿皮里面，是硬的芯。
lines.en: Under this green skin is a hard core.

lines.zh: 你比我想的高，但也没高多少。
lines.en: You are taller than I thought, but not by much.

lines.zh: 我在看你腰上有没有叶子。
lines.en: I am checking whether you have leaves at your waist.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖过来，正好压住我的根。
lines.en: Your shadow falls over and pins down my roots.

lines.zh: 我没有眼白，只有两条缝。
lines.en: I have no whites in my eyes, only two slits.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西，那不算吃的。
lines.en: I stare at what you hold; that does not count as food.

lines.zh: 你的皮很薄，闻起来有汗味。
lines.en: Your skin is thin and smells of sweat.

lines.zh: 抬头要费点力气，我的秆子硬。
lines.en: Lifting my head takes effort; my stalk is stiff.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，叶刃够得到你。
lines.en: You stand too close; my leaf blades can reach you.

lines.zh: 你一进门我就认出活的动静。
lines.en: The moment you entered, I recognized the sound of something alive.

lines.zh: 别对我挥手，我以为你要扯我的叶。
lines.en: Do not wave at me; I think you mean to pull my leaves.

lines.zh: 你像看一株庄稼一样看我，很失礼。
lines.en: You look at me like a crop, and that is rude.

lines.zh: 你眼里有个绿色的东西，那是我。
lines.en: There is something green in your eyes, and it is me.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我一截叶子，秆子还在。
lines.en: You cut off a leaf section; the stalk remains.

lines.zh: 绿色的汁从我身上流下来，很凉。
lines.en: Green juice runs down me, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 疼，但植物不会因为疼就倒。
lines.en: It hurts, but a plant does not fall from pain.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在棒子上，粒碎了几颗。
lines.en: That cut struck my cob and shattered a few kernels.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，根还牢牢抓着土。
lines.en: I swayed, but my roots still grip the soil.

lines.zh: 你以为砍断就行？我里面是实的。
lines.en: Think cutting through is enough? I am solid inside.

lines.zh: 我在往回收叶子，别追着砍。
lines.en: I am pulling my leaves in, so stop chasing the cut.

lines.zh: 伤口的味道会招来花园里别的东西。
lines.en: The smell of the wound will draw other things here.

lines.zh: 你砍得动我，说明你力气不小。
lines.en: You can cut me, which means you are strong.

lines.zh: 我记下这一下，等会还你两下。
lines.en: I noted that blow; I will return it twice.

lines.zh: 你举着面包晃，我不吃熟的东西。
lines.en: You wave bread at me; I do not eat cooked things.

lines.zh: 那袋骨粉拿远点，我讨厌被催长。
lines.en: Keep that bone meal away; I hate being forced to grow.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手上的汗，比面包香。
lines.en: I smell the sweat on your hands, sweeter than bread.

lines.zh: 拿食物逗一株玉米，很好笑吗。
lines.en: Is it funny, teasing a corn stalk with food?

lines.zh: 你再举高一点，我就跳起来咬。
lines.en: Raise it a little more and I will jump and bite.

lines.zh: 我喝土里的水，不吃你喂的。
lines.en: I drink from the soil, not from your hand.

lines.zh: 你手里那把麦子，是我的远亲。
lines.en: The wheat in your hand is a distant relative of mine.

lines.zh: 别用胡萝卜试我，我不是兔子。
lines.en: Do not test me with carrots; I am not a rabbit.

lines.zh: 我不跟你走，除非你把手伸过来。
lines.en: I will not follow you unless you reach out your hand.

lines.zh: 收起那点吃的，站着别动就好。
lines.en: Put the food away and just stand still.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你的衣服会沾满绿汁。
lines.en: Bump me once and your clothes will be covered in green juice.

lines.zh: 我身上全是硬粒，你别靠太近。
lines.en: I am all hard kernels; do not come too close.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘会划手，你最好绕开。
lines.en: My leaf edges cut hands, so you had better go around.

lines.zh: 你推我，我只晃了一下，根还在土里。
lines.en: You push me, I only sway; my roots still hold the soil.

lines.zh: 别贴着我站，汁会渗进你的布。
lines.en: Do not stand against me; the juice seeps into cloth.

lines.zh: 碰到我时，秆子里的水会响一声。
lines.en: Touch me and the water in my stalk knocks once.

lines.zh: 你肩膀撞上我的棒子，很硬吧。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my cob; hard, is it not?

lines.zh: 我这身叶子不是给人靠的。
lines.en: These leaves of mine are not for leaning on.

lines.zh: 挤过来也行，正好让我抓住你。
lines.en: Come squeeze in; it saves me the trouble of grabbing you.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我的叶尖才松开。
lines.en: Step back half a pace and my leaf tips let go.

lines.zh: 我们不必靠近，风会替我们办完。
lines.en: We need not touch; the wind finishes it for us.

lines.zh: 我的须上沾着粉，你带了一点来吗。
lines.en: There is pollen on my silk; did you bring any?

lines.zh: 两条秆子靠一靠，就是全部仪式。
lines.en: Two stalks leaning together is the whole ceremony.

lines.zh: 后代是一把粒，撒下去各自长。
lines.en: Our children are a handful of kernels, scattered to grow apart.

lines.zh: 花园里的玉米都是我的远亲。
lines.en: Every corn in this garden is a distant cousin of mine.

lines.zh: 别看着，植物的事没什么好看。
lines.en: Do not watch; plant business is nothing to look at.

lines.zh: 我的花粉落在你袖子上，别拍掉。
lines.en: My pollen landed on your sleeve; do not brush it off.

lines.zh: 等雨季来，我们就在同一片土里。
lines.en: When the rains come, we will share the same soil.

lines.zh: 我把最饱满的粒留给土，不留给人。
lines.en: I leave the fullest kernels to the soil, not to people.

lines.zh: 交配？我们只交换一点黄色的粉。
lines.en: Mating? We only trade a little yellow dust.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用叶子把东西卷起来。
lines.en: I have no hands; I can only curl a leaf around things.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币卡在我的叶鞘里，出不去。
lines.en: This coin is stuck in my leaf sheath and will not come out.

lines.zh: 我夹起一块石头，然后把它捏碎。
lines.en: I pinch up a stone and then crush it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我用根须拨一拨。
lines.en: I nudge fallen things about with my root tips.

lines.zh: 你掉的面包我捡了，但我不会吃。
lines.en: I picked up your dropped bread, but I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 我夹着它走了三步，又掉了。
lines.en: I carried it three steps before dropping it again.

lines.zh: 叶子不听话，卷不住圆的东西。
lines.en: My leaves disobey and cannot grip anything round.

lines.zh: 那把剑我捡起来了，可惜没手腕。
lines.en: I picked up that sword, but I have no wrist.

lines.zh: 我把你的帽子顶在棒子上，挺合适。
lines.en: I put your hat on my cob; it fits rather well.

lines.zh: 捡东西的时候，秆子会弯得很低。
lines.en: When I pick things up, my stalk bends very low.

lines.zh: 你一踏进花园，我就把根拔出来了。
lines.en: The moment you stepped into the garden, I pulled up my roots.

lines.zh: 活的，会动，会流血，就是你了。
lines.en: Alive, moving, able to bleed, so it is you.

lines.zh: 你身上没有土味，你是从外面来的。
lines.en: You carry no soil smell; you come from outside.

lines.zh: 那边的叶子全朝你转过去了。
lines.en: Every leaf over there has turned toward you.

lines.zh: 不用喊，我从一开始就看着你。
lines.en: No need to shout; I have watched you from the start.

lines.zh: 这一棒有十一点的力道，够你退两步。
lines.en: This cob hits for eleven points, enough to push you back.

lines.zh: 我挑中你，因为你走得最慢。
lines.en: I chose you because you walk the slowest.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我脚边的苗，这事记下了。
lines.en: You crushed the seedlings by my feet; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 花园今天缺一份新的肥料。
lines.en: This garden is short one fresh batch of fertilizer.

lines.zh: 秆子绷紧的声音，就是开始的信号。
lines.en: The creak of a tensing stalk is the signal to begin.

lines.zh: 我跟着你绕，叶子擦着你的脚跟。
lines.en: I circle with you, leaves brushing your heels.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就先到左边等着。
lines.en: You go left, so I arrive on the left first and wait.

lines.zh: 我不急，你跑不出整个花园。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; you cannot outrun the whole garden.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在我听来像鼓点。
lines.en: Your footsteps sound like drumbeats to me.

lines.zh: 我把你往那排枯篱笆的方向逼。
lines.en: I am herding you toward that row of dead fencing.

lines.zh: 你回头看了三次，我一次没眨。
lines.en: You looked back three times; I never blinked once.

lines.zh: 我数着你喘气的间隔往前挪。
lines.en: I count the gaps between your breaths and close in.

lines.zh: 别躲树后，我的叶子比树还宽。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the tree; my leaves are wider than it.

lines.zh: 我围着你的影子走，一圈比一圈近。
lines.en: I walk around your shadow, closer with each circle.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角了，只是还没发现。
lines.en: You have backed into the corner and have not noticed.

lines.zh: 我整根秆子甩过来，叶边先到。
lines.en: I swing my whole stalk; the leaf edge lands first.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你胸口，绿汁溅开。
lines.en: This lands on your chest and green juice sprays.

lines.zh: 我的棒子敲下去，声音闷得吓人。
lines.en: My cob comes down with a sickening dull sound.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，叶子会把你的手划开。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand; the leaf will open it.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，我这一身就是武器。
lines.en: I need no weapon; this whole body is one.

lines.zh: 这一击的力气，够敲碎一块木板。
lines.en: This blow could split a wooden plank.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的须还挂在你脸上。
lines.en: As you pull back, my silk still clings to your face.

lines.zh: 我打得慢，但每一下都落在同一处。
lines.en: I strike slowly, but every blow lands in the same place.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我被打的时候没人问过。
lines.en: Does it hurt? Nobody asked me when I was struck.

lines.zh: 再来一下，你会听见自己骨头的响。
lines.en: One more and you will hear your own bones.

lines.zh: 土裂开，我先伸出两片叶子。
lines.en: The soil splits and I push out two leaves first.

lines.zh: 花园里又长出一株会走的东西。
lines.en: Another walking thing has grown in the garden.

lines.zh: 我从腐叶堆里站起来，身上还是湿的。
lines.en: I rise from the leaf litter still wet.

lines.zh: 这地方阳光够，够我长得很硬。
lines.en: There is enough sun here to grow me hard.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，第一件事是找活物。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, the first task is finding something alive.

lines.zh: 别踩那片新土，我刚从那儿出来。
lines.en: Do not step on that fresh soil; I just came out of it.

lines.zh: 根还没扎稳，我就想追人了。
lines.en: My roots are not set, and already I want to chase.

lines.zh: 花园的土把我推出来，说该我了。
lines.en: The garden soil pushed me out and said it was my turn.

lines.zh: 我一长成，就带着满身敌意。
lines.en: I grew up carrying hostility all over my body.

lines.zh: 我在叶子里藏了九十五点命。
lines.en: I keep ninety-five points of life tucked inside my leaves.

lines.zh: 刚冒头就闻到你的味道，运气不错。
lines.en: I smelled you the moment I sprouted; good luck.

lines.zh: 整片花园在响，是新的玉米冒头。
lines.en: The whole garden rustles; new corn is coming up.

lines.zh: 叶子一着火就卷，我最怕这个。
lines.en: My leaves curl the moment they catch fire, and I dread it.

lines.zh: 摔下去时，我的棒子先着地。
lines.en: As I fell, my cob hit the ground first.

lines.zh: 水灌进叶鞘，我连叫都叫不出。
lines.en: Water fills my leaf sheaths and I cannot even cry out.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的粒全打散了。
lines.en: The blast scattered every kernel out of me.

lines.zh: 那支箭钉在我秆子上，晃得难受。
lines.en: That arrow is stuck in my stalk and wobbles painfully.

lines.zh: 魔法穿过我时，粒都在发麻。
lines.en: As the magic passes through, every kernel goes numb.

lines.zh: 土里没东西了，我的叶子开始黄。
lines.en: The soil has nothing left, and my leaves are yellowing.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整株都在冒烟。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my whole stalk is smoking.

lines.zh: 掉进空处，连根都一起散了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, even my roots came apart.
